text:
maria: seeing p99 latency spikes for inference pods in us-east-1d since ~07:20 UTC, multiple SLO alerts :rotating_light:
kevin: noticed same. Packet loss counters between hosts climbed. any infra changes this morning?
deploy-bot: kernel-5.15.22 rolled to compute-us-east pool at 07:05 UTC by rollout/compute-2026-03
sre-jen: can you paste `tc qdisc show dev eth0` from an affected host?
kevin: grabbing output from host compute-3a:
```
qdisc fq_codel 8001: dev eth0 root refcnt 2 limit 10240 flows 1024 quantum 1514 target 5.0ms interval 100.0ms memory_limit 4Mb
qdisc pfifo_fast 0: dev cni0 root refcnt 2 bands 3 priomap  1 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2
```
patrick: hmm we usually avoid putting `fq_codel` on the compute NICs; that was supposed to be set only on mgmt interfaces. Could be cloud-init or distro default after kernel bump toggled the network stack behavior.
maria: we also saw mlx5 errors on a couple nodes earlier: `mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: cq error: overflow` in dmesg
sre-jen: if fq_codel is doing host-level shaping it can interact badly with RDMA NICs / large MTU paths and create reordering + drops. That would blow up tail latency for small UDP/TCP bursts used by our KV cache and inference shards.
kevin: ran `ethtool -k eth0` — GSO/GRO were off on affected hosts, oddly. Likely kernel toggled off offloads for safety on certain drivers.
patrick: immediate test: remove fq_codel on one node and switch to pfifo_fast to see effect. `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root pfifo_fast` (testing node compute-3a)
maria: did that on compute-3a at 07:42. p99 for the inference route dropped from 210ms -> 18ms within 3 mins :eyes:
sre-jen: good signal. don't do wide replace yet. Root cause path: distro cloud-init flag `network.root_qdisc=fq_codel` accidentally enabled via a packaging change in the kernel-package. We need to revert that on remaining nodes and patch the image.
kevin: will add a guard in the node bootstrap: disable root qdisc mutation in our cloud-init template and add `--no-root-qdisc` to the CNI config if present.
patrick: long-term: ensure RDMA-capable NICs (mlx5) keep offloads and MTU consistent; add a node-level check that validates no host-level shaping on compute NICs before joining pool.
incident-bot: created incident infra-2026-03-18-342 for host traffic-shaping causing inference SLO regressions
maria: creating a short postmortem draft and tagging owners. rolling kernel rollback for remaining nodes started (controlled, one AZ at a time).
kevin: update: rolling rollback paused after second node showed same fq_codel; will run script to scrub cloud-init and then reboot nodes with monitored rollback.
sre-jen: next actions: (1) scrub image and disable root qdisc flag, (2) run canary patch to restore offloads on RDMA nodes, (3) add telemetry to alert if host-level qdisc != expected, (4) postmortem and follow-up CL to CNI config.
patrick: thanks all. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll push logs + `tc` outputs into the incident ticket for context. keep pings here for progress.
